reproduction_target: Genome-wide codon usage bias (CUB) analysis across the fungal order Sordariales. Reproduce, from published Sordariales genomes (dataset of Hensen et al. 2023): (1) high-quality CDS filtering; (2) amino-acid frequency, RSCU, GC3, GC12 computation; (3) automatic clustering of genomes by amino-acid composition and RSCU; (4) ancestral-state reconstruction of GC3 over a kingdom-wide fungal phylogeny; (5) ribosomal-gene identification (translate -> InterProScan/Pfam) for a CAI reference set; (6) effective number of codons (ENC) and codon adaptation index (CAI) per genome; (7) neutrality plots (GC12 vs GC3 regression slope) and ENC/GC3 plots to separate selection from mutational bias; (8) family-level statistics (pairwise Wilcoxon + Bonferroni, Pearson correlation, phylogenetically independent contrasts).

steps.label: High-quality CDS extraction & filtering from annotated Sordariales genomes (custom bash scripts in Genefiltering/): keep spliced CDS with length >=100 bp, no partial codons, no internal stop codons, both start and stop codons. Code: gene_filtering.sh uses agat_sp_extract_sequences.pl / agat_sp_filter_feature_from_kill_list.pl (agat=0.8.0) + seqkit fx2tab (seqkit=2.4.0) + awk; fasta folding via fasta_formatter (fastx_toolkit=0.0.14)

Amino-acid composition, RSCU, GC3 and GC12 per-genome computation with BioKIT V0.1.2 (also used for per-gene GC1/GC2/GC3 in neutrality plots). Code: biokit installed via `pip install jlsteenwyk-biokit -U` (mutable latest), not version-locked
Automatic clustering of genomes by amino-acid composition and RSCU with the pheatmap R package. Code: r-env.yml does NOT list pheatmap; resolved as latest at env-create time

Ancestral-state reconstruction of GC3 over a 689-species kingdom-wide fungal phylogeny (Wint et al. 2022) with phytools V0.6.44 (ContMap function). Code: r-env.yml does NOT list phytools; not captured in any env file
Translation of genes for ribosomal-gene identification with seqkit translate. Code: seqkit=2.4.0 pinned inside agat-environment.yml (non-lock exact pin)

Protein-domain annotation with InterProScan (-appl Pfam) to compile the set of PFAM eukaryotic ribosomal genes used as the CAI reference set. Code: InterProScan is absent from every conda-env/*.yml and carries no version anywhere in the repo

Effective number of codons (ENC) and codon adaptation index (CAI) per genome-wide CDS with CodonW V1.4.2 (-totals setting; correspondence analysis on ribosomal genes as CAI reference). Code: codonw-environment.yml pins codonw=1.4.4 (non-lock; CONFLICTS with prose V1.4.2)
Neutrality plots: per-gene GC12 vs GC3 regression slope estimation with the ggpubr R package. Code: r-env.yml lists r-ggpubr with NO version (mutable latest at env-create)
ENC/GC3 plots (expected-ENC curve, dNC per-gene selection metric) and figure generation with the ggplot2 R package. Code: r-env.yml lists r-ggplot2 with NO version (mutable latest)
Phylogenetically independent contrasts to correct trait correlations for phylogenetic dependence with the ape R package. Code: r-env.yml does NOT list ape; not captured

Family-level statistics in R V4.4.1 / RStudio: Shapiro-Wilk normality, pairwise Wilcoxon rank-sum (pairwise.wilcox.test, Bonferroni adjustment), Pearson correlation (cor.test). Code: r-env.yml lists r-base with NO version pin (prose V4.4.1 not enforced)
